Implemented the SSRF fix:

- Protocol-relative URLs are no longer treated as absolute, so `baseURL` is always applied (`lib/helpers/isAbsoluteURL.js`).
- Node requests no longer fall back to `http://localhost`; protocol-relative URLs without a base URL now throw `ERR_INVALID_URL` (`lib/adapters/http.js`).
